cause: After driving past a large dog under a desk and reversing back out, the robot drove forward into the dog's hind legs (around 00:07.375 in the video / 6.86 s in the IMU log) and was tipped backward onto its rear (~85° pitch-up, ay_g ≈ 0.95 g, az_g ≈ 0.1 g at t = 7.16–9.56 s) before rolling onto its right side (ax_g ≈ 1.0 g, az_g ≈ -0.1 g from t = 9.96 s onward). Video timestamps lag the IMU log by ~1.3–1.4 s with frozen video frames (e.g., 00:07.500–00:08.000), so the IMU is trusted for timing and kinematics while the video is trusted for identifying the dog collision.
evidence: 00:00.000–00:01.875 (video) / t=0.02–0.42 s (IMU): Robot starts on indoor carpet facing a standing white dog (~0.8 m ahead, ~0.15 m to the left of the initial path).

00:02.000–00:03.750 (video) / t=0.52–2.40 s (IMU): Robot accelerates forward (ay_g = 0.467 g at t=0.52 s), passes to the right of the dog's legs, and brakes to a stop under the desk (ay_g = -0.667 g at t=2.20 s).
00:05.125–00:06.000 (video) / t=3.60–4.60 s (IMU): Robot reverses out from under the desk (ay_g = -0.370 g at t=3.70 s) and stops directly behind the dog's hind legs (~0.25 m away).

00:06.625–00:07.500 (video) / t=6.56–6.96 s (IMU): Robot accelerates forward into the dog's hind legs (ay_g = 0.432 g at t=6.56 s, speed ~0.45 m/s); video frames freeze between 00:07.500 and 00:08.000.

00:08.375–00:11.125 (video) / t=7.06–9.66 s (IMU): Robot flips backward ~85° onto its rear/back (ay_g spikes to 1.426 g at t=7.16 s and settles near 0.90–0.98 g while az_g drops to ~0.0–0.25 g), pointing the camera up at the ceiling fan and the underside of the dog for ~2.6 s.
00:11.250–00:11.875 (video) / t=9.86–11.92 s (IMU): Robot falls from its back onto its right side (ax_g ≈ 0.93–1.04 g, ay_g ≈ 0.0 g, az_g ≈ -0.05 to -0.28 g), coming to rest sideways on the carpet.

Cross-check: Video and IMU show the exact same motion sequence and 2.6 s pitched-up duration, but video timestamps lag IMU timestamps by ~1.3–1.4 s and suffer from frame freezes; we trust the IMU for exact timing and the video for scene identification.

other_factors: Large dog standing in narrow indoor gap between couch and desk
Robot reverses and re-approaches directly into the dog's hind legs
Video stream lags IMU log by ~1.3–1.4 s with dropped/frozen frames

unknowns: Exact clock offset (~1.3–1.4 s) between video frame timestamps and IMU log timestamps due to camera stream freezes
Whether a human or the dog's leg movement actively lifted/pushed the front of the robot during the frozen video frames (00:07.500–00:08.000)
